title: Give an installed atrium a default instance that does not depend on the caller environment
notes: Office Mac, 2026-11-24: ~/.local/bin/atrium was a wrapper exporting SYNTOPICA_DATA=~/wiki. uv tool upgrade atrium (run by RocketUpdater) replaced it with the uv entry point. From then on every caller without the variable failed: the atrium-context plugin runs atrium context with the Claude Code process environment and got exit 1 in a repository (index not found), shown as Retrieval failed or timed out twice; atrium record-session answered no pending checkpoint. With SYNTOPICA_DATA set the same commands answer in about 1 s.

Worked around on that Mac with SYNTOPICA_DATA in ~/.zshenv and in the env block of ~/.claude/settings.json. The MCP server, the Stop hook and the LaunchAgents already carried the variable; the plugin, the SessionStart recall hook and the SessionEnd refresh hook did not.
Also misleading: record-session exits 3 with no pending checkpoint when the real cause is that no instance was resolved.
done_when: A machine installed per the documented steps keeps answering atrium context and record-session after uv tool upgrade atrium with no SYNTOPICA_DATA in the caller environment, or the install step that sets the variable for every caller is documented and checked by doctor
